item.title: Stephen Thompson MBE, to Step Down as Managing Director and from the Club’s Board of Directors as of the 31st March 2026.
item.description: Following the announcement of the takeover of Dagenham & Redbridge Football Club by the Happy Fan Group, Stephen Thompson MBE has decided to step down from his role as Managing Director and his position on the Club’s Board of Directors. The post Stephen Thompson MBE, to Step Down as Managing Director and from the Club’s Board of Directors as of the 31st March 2026. appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: GLOBAL SUPERSTAR KSI JOINS DAGENHAM & REDBRIDGE FC AS SHAREHOLDER AND STRATEGIC PARTNER
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge FC is thrilled to announce its most significant strategic partnership to date: Olajide Olayinka Williams Olatunji, known globally as KSI, has officially joined the club as a shareholder and strategic partner. The post GLOBAL SUPERSTAR KSI JOINS DAGENHAM & REDBRIDGE FC AS SHAREHOLDER AND STRATEGIC PARTNER appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Kalambayi recalled from Kidderminster Loan

item.title: Kien Connolly returns to Colchester
item.description: We can confirm that forward Kien Connolly has returned to Colchester United following the expiration of his loan spell. The post Kien Connolly returns to Colchester appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Hemmings joins Oxford City on loan
item.description: Following the expiration of his loan at Kidderminster Harriers, forward Ashley Hemmings has now completed a loan move to National League North side Oxford City until the end of the season. The post Hemmings joins Oxford City on loan appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
